stance_rationale: The draft honestly reports that C21 interaction is non-graduating, but it cannot finalize as a QEPM alpha package because required alpha artifacts are missing and several PIT/verification gates are unresolved. The weakest residual overclaim is the route suggestion for the revision marginal, not the negative conclusion on C21 itself.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Internal c21_intermediate.rds has 256 monthly score dates, but required alpha_scores.parquet and weights.csv are absent at the specified paths, so downstream schedule use is not verifiable.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: z_rev and z_flow are naturally positive-oriented; no NEGATE_FACTORS or manual FLIP_SIGN detected.
Scripts use Date<=sig_date, but no Usable_Date proof exists for consensus/flow; same-day investor-flow timing remains unresolved.
Orthogonality targets were recomputed from raw caches/direct parquet loads rather than load_month_factors(); no lineage file documents an approved exception.
No regime, drawdown, or overlay signal is used.
No raw financial statement lag is used; consensus inputs are filtered by Date<=sig_date, subject to the C14 Usable_Date caveat.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory alpha delivery artifacts are missing: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260621_003/alpha_scores.parquet, covariance.parquet, stage_artifacts/WT_D20260621_003, qepm/mailbox/.../weights.csv, and artifact_lineage.json were not present; this blocks RF-A7 schedule verification despite the RDS containing multi-date scores.

The flow leg uses frollsum align=right and roll_asof Date<=sig_date, so month-end t-day investor flow is included; the request/backlog explicitly called for t-1 settlement or a lag-1 robustness cell. The phrase that a t-1 retreat would only weaken an already-dead leg is not verification.

The anchor screen has turnover_annual=18.04x, exceeding the 11.00x hard turnover ceiling, and remains a single-sleeve top-20 long-only construction without an AX-007 exception. This is acceptable only as a rejected negative result, not as a candidate alpha_hat.

Sector-neutral recomputation shows ICIR collapsing from 0.1544 to 0.0202, an 86.9% drop, triggering the RF-A4 spurious-factor warning and weakening the claimed residual value of the revision marginal.

C15 and orthogonality are incomplete: factor targets were recomputed from caches instead of the canonical loader, active-return rho is high for INV10/C19, and the required M-cluster active-correlation checks were not produced.

Multiple-testing protection is under-documented: 18 cells were reported, DSR is absent, Harvey/rank-IC gates fail, and the draft relies on a chain-rule waiver without a lineage-backed selection record.

The residual recommendation to route M_revOnly to DPL/FR is fragile: M_revOnly is below the 2.95 hurdle at 2.795, overlaps the C02/C19 consensus family, and has not passed book-marginal or family-saturation checks.

supporting_arguments: The draft's main empirical conclusion is conservative: C21_G anchor PORT_t=0.939, OOS retention=-0.672, Calmar=0.048, and graduation_candidate=false.
The internal RDS score panel is multi-date rather than single-snapshot: 256 monthly sig_dates from 2005-01-31 to 2026-04-30.
RF-A5 is not the main issue: top-decile median ADV is about 10.3bn KRW and only about 0.35% of top-decile rows are below 2e8 ADV.
unresolved_disputes: Whether direct raw cache loading is an approved C15 exception for this alpha, and why no artifact_lineage.json records it.
Whether t-day investor flow is actionable at the month-end signal time; the package needs a strict Date<sig_date lag-1 rerun.
Whether M_revOnly deserves a separate WorkTask instead of being routed inside a failed interaction package.
Whether DSR was legitimately waived under chain selection rules for this exact 18-cell robustness grid.
weakest_assumption: That the revision marginal remains a useful DPL/FR candidate after the C21 interaction fails, despite sub-Harvey t, consensus-family overlap, sector-neutral collapse, turnover above the hard ceiling, and missing book-marginal validation.
rebuttal_required: Produce canonical alpha_scores.parquet with Date/Ticker/score and artifact_lineage.json, or explicitly mark the package as negative-only with no downstream alpha_hat.
Rerun the anchor with investor flow strictly lagged to Date<sig_date and report the delta.
Add sector-neutral IC/portfolio diagnostics and acknowledge RF-A4.
Use load_month_factors() for orthogonality targets or document the approved C15 exception.
Remove or quarantine the M_revOnly route claim unless a separate marginal/book-saturation test passes.
rationalization_red_flags: conservative t-1 retreat would only weaken the already-dead flow leg
DSR gate not applied per chain rule

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with the negative C21 conclusion, but not with artifact/PIT sufficiency or the residual revision-marginal routing claim. Forge/Codex/Architect two-source PASS is not demonstrated.

alpha_specific_questions: Can C21_G survive a strict investor-flow t-1 lag without using any same-day disclosed flow?
Does the sector-neutral collapse mean the small positive rank IC is mainly sector or coverage bias?
If the interaction is dead, why is M_revOnly being routed here rather than opened as a separate consensus-family marginal WorkTask?
